\section{CORA coverage and findings per class}
\label{app:formalization}

Figs.~\ref{fig:formalization-classes-sets}, \ref{fig:formalization-classes-contdynamics},
\ref{fig:formalization-classes-others} and \ref{fig:formalization-classes-specification} show the
CORA methods per class and
Fig.~\ref{fig:formalization-findings} the formalized results of the papers per group, by how they fared.
Not in the bars are 528 CORA methods that are out of scope, by reason MATLAB plumbing (235), plotting and display (129), conversions between MATLAB storage formats and file converters (76), random sampling (51), solver encodings (23), deprecated (14), and 1095 results
of the papers, by reason not a claim (559), restated (409), not covered (93), mathlib (23), done differently (11).
The directories \texttt{matrixSet}, \texttt{discrDynamics} and \texttt{converter} of CORA are
shown only in aggregate, as the bar \emph{Others} of Fig.~\ref{fig:formalization} (a), without a
breakdown per class.
